II — In Depth

Featured Case Study

Featured Project

Vessel Beauty — 2023

From mass-market
to monument.

Vessel Beauty had the product. What they lacked was an identity proportional to it — a prestige skincare line trapped inside the visual language of a department store mid-shelf. Warm formulas, cold packaging, no story.

Over eight months, I rebuilt the brand from the inside out: a new typographic system that felt hand-pressed and heirloom; an art direction framework for photography that privileged texture and light over clinical perfection; packaging redesign across 14 SKUs; and a global launch campaign anchored on the line "Made for skin that remembers."

The result was a brand that looked like it had existed for decades — and launched into 12 international markets with coverage in Vogue, WSJ Magazine, and Monocle.

0 % lift in brand recall
$2.1M earned media at launch
0 markets entered
III — Method

How I Work

01

Immerse

I start where most creatives stop — obsessively inside the world of the brand. Category audits, cultural mapping, competitive dissection. I need to feel the gap before I can fill it.

02

Decode

Every brand has an unspoken thesis — a core tension or aspiration they can't yet name. I surface it through stakeholder dialogue, audience research, and iterative positioning until the insight crystallizes.

03

Construct

Concept to system. I build the visual and verbal architecture — typography, color, image world, tone — then stress-test it across every touchpoint before a single pixel is finalized.

04

Amplify

Creative direction doesn't end at delivery. I stay close through production, campaign rollout, and first-response analysis — making sure the work lands the way it was imagined, then learning what to carry forward.

About Mira

Fifteen years
of making brands
unforgettable.

"I came up in editorial — Séquence, then Fable — where the work had to be exceptional because the budget wasn't. That scarcity taught me to think before I reach for the lens."

Mira Vale is an independent creative director working across brand systems, editorial campaigns, and art-directed product launches. Based between Berlin and London, she works with clients who have something real to say and need the language to say it — at scale, with permanence.

Before going independent in 2015, she led creative at Séquence Magazine and served as Senior Art Director at Fable Publishing. Her work has been recognised by D&AD, the Art Directors Club, and Cannes Lions.
